plan.title: Saved eRFX draft add control availability

steps.note: Create the saved eRFX draft whose screen is needed for the check.
Enable eRFX project creation required for the draft.
Apply the additional configuration specified by the case.
Configure an eRFX draft with an RFQ stage.
Configure the RFQ stage before selecting its template.
Apply a pricing template so the draft can be saved.
Save the eRFX event as a draft.
Return to the events list to reach the saved draft.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Closest available plus-control check; this opens the stage-add menu, not the vendor-add control.
Assert the closest catalog-observable add menu state without treating it as evidence about vendor addition.
